fields.name: PatientUserId
fields.description: IAM user itemId of the patient who granted this consent. Indexed for row-level lookup.

fields.name: GranteeOrgId
fields.description: IAM organization itemId that the patient is granting access to. Indexed for row-level lookup.

fields.name: HomeOrgId
fields.description: The patient's home org at the time this row was written. Read-only cache; the source of truth lives in OrganizationMember. Used to compute CrossOrgShare.

fields.name: CrossOrgShare
fields.description: True when HomeOrgId != GranteeOrgId -- the patient is sharing data with another clinic/hospital. Such grants are always read-only at the API layer regardless of scope.

fields.name: DataAccessMode
fields.description: read|write. Cross-org grants are always 'read'. Within-home-org grants default to 'read' but may be upgraded to 'write' (used by an org the patient already belongs to).

fields.name: GrantedAt
fields.description: When the patient granted this consent.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: Required: every consent grant must have an expiry. Default 90 days at creation; the patient can shorten or extend. After expiry, the grantee org's data queries return 403; the row stays in history for audit.

fields.name: RevokedAt
fields.description: When the patient revoked this consent. Append-only via a new row in PatientConsent rather than editing this row.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Free-text note from the patient or branch_manager. Subject to FR-19 firewall scan at write time.
